20:44 Metallotolerants (Heavy metal)
21:54 Radioresistants (Radiation)
24:02 Astrotolerants (Space)

If you’re seeing this, consider leaving a comment. It helps me a lot :)

Contact me here: daninblueofficial@gmail.com

FTC disclaimer: This video was sponsored by Brilliant
Video edited by me

WHO AM I?
Hey, I’m Dan. I double majored in biology and psychology and like to make videos about evolution and behaviour and stuff. I have a lot of thoughts and need creative outlets at all times, so making these videos is a great way to cope with the struggle of indefinite existence. I plan to stick around on YouTube for a while, so I hope to see you around for years to come :)
